$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Search in a service

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Find an item by name inside a service.
useFor: A person who knows what they want.
notFor: Browsing with no query (use the landing).

allowed: Toolbar · Modal / Search or Secondary Pages / Search.
forbidden: A placeholder that does not say what can be searched.

allowed: category-chips; recent searches of this person.
forbidden: Trending or sponsored terms without a label.

allowed: cards-slider (grid) or cards-list with one MediaCard type; EmptyState for no results.
forbidden: Sponsored results without an ad label.
A blank area for no results.
The older Tab Bar together with BottomNav.

rules: Three states: before typing, results, no results.
No results says so, keeps the query and offers the categories.
Results use one card type so prices compare (M9P rule 8).
A paid position is labelled as an ad (M4).
The field keeps focus and the keyboard never covers the first result.

allocation.App level: L2 · search is the P3 route: where an item rests until a step promotes it.
allocation.Signal: Search fallback rate per service is the metric that judges any demotion (M9S).

measure.success: Searches that end in an item view

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.

notes: Bottom navigation: BottomNav together with the older Tab Bar (N14).
example.inTheFlowToday: All three search states are built from List Screen · Empty State.
